title: Simulation 3D Vision Detection Generator
text: Detect objects and lanes from measurements in 3D simulation environment, 4 outputs, {Mounting location} sets Sensor mounting location; {Sensor identifier} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Parent name} sets the name of parent vehicle, {Specify offset} sets the offset from mounting location, {Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)} sets the translation offset relative to mounting location, {Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} sets the rotational offset relative to mounting location, {Sample time}, {Types of detections generated by sensor}, {Maximum number of reported detections}, {Maximum number of reported lanes}, {Distance from parent for computing lane boundaries} sets the distances from parent frame at which to compute lane boundaries, {Source of object bus name}, {Object bus name}, {Source of output lane bus name}, {Specify an output lane bus name} sets the lane bus name, {Maximum detection range (m)}, {Bounding box accuracy (pixels)}, {Smoothing filter noise intensity (m/s^2)} sets the noise intensity used for filtering position and velocity, {Maximum detectable object speed (m/s)}, {Maximum allowed occlusion for detector} sets the maximum allowed occlusion of an object, {Minimum detectable image size of an object (pixels)} sets the minimum height and width of an object, {Probability of detecting a target} sets the probability of detection, {Number of false positives per image} sets the number of false detections generated by vision sensor per, {Minimum lane size in image (pixels)} sets the maximum size of lane, {Accuracy of lane boundary (pixels)}, {Add noise to measurements} enables adding noise to vision sensor, {Select method to specify initial seed} sets the method to specify random number generator seed, {Initial seed} sets the random number generator seed, {Focal length (pixels)} sets the camera focal length, {Optical center (pixels)} sets the optical center of camera, {Image size (pixels)} sets the image size produced by camera, {Radial distortion coefficients}, {Tangential distortion coefficients}, {Skew of the camera axes} sets the skew angle of camera axes, {Output actor truth} sets the output ground truth of actors and {Output lane truth} sets the output ground truth of lane boundaries. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sensor identifier
params.values: Unique sensor identifier 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Parent name
params.values: Name of parent vehicle Scene Origin (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: Sensor mounting location Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center |...

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: Specify offset from mounting location off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: Translation offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: Rotational offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Types of detections generated by sensor
params.values: Types of detections generated by sensor Lanes and objects (default) | Objects only | Lanes only | Lanes with occlusion

params.name: Maximum number of reported detections
params.values: Maximum number of reported detections 50 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Maximum number of reported lanes
params.values: Maximum number of reported lanes 30 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Distance from parent for computing lane boundaries
params.values: Distances from parent frame at which to compute lane boundaries 0:0.5:9.5 (default) | N -element real-valued vector

params.name: Source of object bus name
params.values: Source of object bus name Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Object bus name
params.values: Object bus name BusObjectDetections | valid bus name

params.name: Source of output lane bus name
params.values: Source of output lane bus name Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Specify an output lane bus name
params.values: Lane bus name BusLaneDetections (default) | valid bus name

params.name: Maximum detection range (m)
params.values: Maximum detection range 150 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Bounding box accuracy (pixels)
params.values: Bounding box accuracy 5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Smoothing filter noise intensity (m/s^2)
params.values: Noise intensity used for filtering position and velocity measurements 5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Maximum detectable object speed (m/s)
params.values: Maximum detectable object speed 50 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Maximum allowed occlusion for detector
params.values: Maximum allowed occlusion of an object 0.5 (default) | real scalar in the range [0 1)

params.name: Minimum detectable image size of an object (pixels)
params.values: Minimum height and width of an object [15,15] (default) | 1-by-2 vector of positive values

params.name: Probability of detecting a target
params.values: Probability of detection 0.9 (default) | positive real scalar less than or equal to 1

params.name: Number of false positives per image
params.values: Number of false detections generated by vision sensor per image 0.1 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Minimum lane size in image (pixels)
params.values: Maximum size of lane [20,3] (default) | 1-by-2 real-valued vector

params.name: Accuracy of lane boundary (pixels)
params.values: Accuracy of lane boundary 3 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Add noise to measurements
params.values: Enable adding noise to vision sensor measurements on (default) | off

params.name: Select method to specify initial seed
params.values: Method to specify random number generator seed Repeatable (default) | Specify seed | Not repeatable

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: Random number generator seed 1 (default) | nonnegative integer less than 2 32

params.name: Focal length (pixels)
params.values: Camera focal length [800,800] (default) | two-element real-valued vector

params.name: Optical center (pixels)
params.values: Optical center of camera [320,240] (default) | two-element real-valued vector

params.name: Image size (pixels)
params.values: Image size produced by camera [480,640] (default) | two-element vector of positive integers

params.name: Radial distortion coefficients
params.values: Radial distortion coefficients [0,0] (default) | two-element real-valued vector | three-element real-valued vector

params.name: Tangential distortion coefficients
params.values: Tangential distortion coefficients [0,0] (default) | two-element real-valued vector

params.name: Skew of the camera axes
params.values: Skew angle of camera axes 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Output actor truth
params.values: Output ground truth of actors off (default) | on

params.name: Output lane truth
params.values: Output ground truth of lane boundaries off (default) | on
